## Use Anonymous Pro in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Anonymous Pro for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Anonymous Pro', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

Anonymous Pro is available from Google Fonts.

## About the Anonymous Pro coding font

A classic monospace font, great for long coding sessions. Anonymous Pro is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Anonymous Pro is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Anonymous Pro FAQ

### Is Anonymous Pro free?

Yes. Anonymous Pro is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Anonymous Pro support ligatures?

No. Anonymous Pro has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Anonymous Pro?

Anonymous Pro is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
